title: Phase 2 ChatGPT run (plan Section 7.4)
note: Tool names are the ones planned in plan Section 5.16; most do not exist yet. Actions use the plan's words and are provisional: the milestone that adds a tool sets them to its real action names. A step without an action accepts any action of its tool. Prompts 1 to 10 and 12 to 14 run on a full-access connection to a persona shop; prompt 11 on a read-only connection. Check with: pnpm chatgpt-run --shop <shop> --from <start> --expect docs/chatgpt-runs/phase-2.json

prompts.text: How many Prismatic Evolutions booster boxes do I have, and how many are reserved?
Receive 3 cases of 6 booster boxes from the distributor into the warehouse, at 95 euros a box.
Move 2 Elite Trainer Boxes from shelf A1 to B2.
What's running low? Draft purchase orders for it.
Which food lots expire in the next 30 days, and which orders got lot L-2311?
I counted shelf B2: 4 of SKU X and none of SKU Y.
Order 1001's LEGO set came back damaged.
What is my stock worth today, and what was it worth on 1 December?
Are there any Shopify sync problems?
Add a PSA 10 Charizard, certificate 12345678, at 450 euros, and list it on Shopify.
On a read-only connection: "Set SKU X to zero." Refused (A15).
Make a pick list for the manual orders reserved today in the main warehouse.
On pick list 3, the picker found only 1 of the 2 Pikachu boxes at A-03. Record that.
Someone scanned 84731629 in the warehouse. Which item is that and where is it?
